breaking.change: The cook records the project's profile in its manifest (`profile "3d"` or `"2d"`, from project.ogt's creation form as before), and `og build`, `og run --device` and the play page's build read it there. A manifest without the line is refused (`no profile line: cook the project again`), so a bundle cooked before this version, including one another project names in `cook { uses }`, is cooked again. web-build.ts's ProjectSettings has no `profile` (the `--settings` JSON og passes carries none), and `og build --publish` refuses a 2D project's 3D-world components after the cook rather than before it.
breaking.fix: Cook again (`og cook`; `og run` and `og build` cook first). Read the profile from cooked/.cook.ogt or og-build.json's `game.profile`, not from the build settings.
